scope: Exam universe (1,042). Bankruptcy-related delistings only (23 names): every delisted exam name was scanned on SEC submissions for 8-K Item 1.03 within [delisting-730d, delisting+400d] plus later chain segments; each hit read in the plan/effective-date 8-K. delisting_settlement_price = 0.0 only where the SEC text explicitly says common equity is cancelled with no distribution; null otherwise (null is NOT zero). Acquisitions are not covered here: engine default (last close) applies; stock-merger cuts are flagged ACQUISITION_STOCK in manifest.csv.

records.note: Effective-date 8-K: all common stock outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Date cancelled and discharged. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Confirmed plan effective: all equity interests (common and Series A preferred) cancelled; no recovery. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan: current equity cancelled and extinguished; holders will not receive or retain any property. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Confirmed plan: Existing Equity Interests (Class 10) cancelled; holders receive no distribution. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan: existing equity interests cancelled, extinguished and discharged; holders receive no distribution. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Confirmed plan: all equity interests including common stock cancelled; holders receive no distribution. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.

Plan: all outstanding common and preferred stock cancelled, shareholders receive no distributions (asset sale to Harbin Pharmaceutical). Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Confirmed plan: common stock cancelled; holders receive no distribution. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Liquidating plan: common stock cancelled for no consideration; company dissolved into liquidating trusts. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan effective: all equity interests cancelled without consideration and have no value (Old Copper Company). Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
2023 plan: holders of existing equity interests receive no distribution; ordinary shares cancelled. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan: all Existing Equity Interests cancelled and extinguished; holders receive no recovery. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan: existing common stock and equity interests cancelled without any distribution. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Confirmed liquidating plan: common stock and warrants cancelled, of no further force or effect; no distribution to equity. Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.

Plan: existing equity discharged and terminated without any distribution or retained property (NYSE delisting preceded the Dec-2020 filing). Numeric zero is the plan recovery, not the last exchange close.
Plan: existing REIT common stock cancelled; holders receive pro rata share of the Existing Common Equity Recovery Pool (a slice of new common stock). Per-share value not fixed.
